reviews.text: Perfect service.

My heartfelt thanks to the entire team, from the doctors, all fantastic, to the scheduling service, to the post-consultation follow-up, to everyone without exception, my eternal gratitude.

I highly recommend them for your furry friends!!

What incredible service we received from Vet Sobre Rodas!

We have a kitten who gets quite aggressive when going to clinics, and we needed to try something different to make things easier for him. We hit the jackpot when we contacted the clinic.
The service is excellent from the first contact. They explain everything we need to know about how the work is done.

Claudia was extremely punctual.

And what about her patience during the service? She even calmed our little jaguar. The cat had been almost 3 years behind on his vaccination record because he couldn't get through the clinics calmly, and she managed to vaccinate him without him even hissing at her. A great achievement haha.

She also vaccinated our kitten and drew blood for analysis. With a lot of patience and care.

We were very happy with everything.

If our little ones don't suffer, we don't suffer either.

Thank you Vet Sobre Rodas.

The best veterinary clinic that has treated my cat so far. They are very friendly, helpful, careful, and the prices are very reasonable, even for home visits. My cat gets stressed from car rides, and this clinic was the best solution.
A special thank you to Dr. Mariana. Nerinho had two home visits and everything went perfectly. Punctual and excellent service.
Highly attentive professionals.
Nice

The consultation went very well! Without a doubt, their comfort is important, and the fact that they are in their own home relieves a lot of stress for them and their owners!

I highly recommend it!!!!!
Thank you for the care you showed my four!
The best veterinarians in the greater Porto area. I recommend them!

Dr. Mariana is super competent and very professional. Both my cats and Lila, the dog, are super sweet.
Just the fact that she doesn't take them out of the house is wonderful.

After the first and only appointment where she received some vaccinations, three days later my dog ​​developed a lump (benign tumor) which required surgery. The rabies vaccination was never recorded in the system until a year later, and now my dog ​​suffers from hypothyroidism. After those vaccinations, many things changed in our dog, and they didn't take any action. I only had to request another appointment and pay another 100 euros to get any information. Irresponsible and completely indifferent to the situation. Excuse my comments, but this is the current reality.

I really liked Dr. Mariana. She explained everything and examined the cookie impeccably. We became clients.
Thank you and keep up the excellent work.
Incredible !!
Today I contacted Vet on Wheels for the first time, they arranged availability super fast, Dr. Mariana made house calls and it was a very good experience, excellent service!

Terrible customer service. The simple act of booking a bath for my dog, who hates baths, and I believe this is the case with many other animals, was met with unprofessionalism from the person who was going to bathe her. I had already heard neighbors make unfavorable comments, and this was confirmed. Luckily, we have Invet 100 meters away, with well-trained people.

They won't last long here if they continue with this attitude.

I recommend this clinic to everyone. The telephone service is excellent, extremely friendly and helpful. I requested a home visit some time ago and everything went very smoothly. Dr. Raquel is very attentive, kind and explains everything perfectly. They are not at all a clinic with the goal of "making money"; they are truly dedicated to the well-being of animals. Congratulations!

Super professional and extremely friendly service.

Considering that one of the cats wasn't very cooperative, Dr. Mariana was very patient and caring towards them.

I highly recommend this service, as it makes the parties much more comfortable in their own space, and the quality/price ratio is undoubtedly very good.
Thank you to Vetsobrerodas for the excellent service provided.

I really enjoyed the consultation with Dr. Mariana, who was extremely punctual and kind. My cat, Nara, doesn't like going to the vet. She had been having problems with tearing, sneezing, and nasal discharge. The empathy she showed allowed her to be examined and her eyes to be handled. It's an allergy to the sand! Next time, I won't be stressed. Thank you, and I wish everyone much success.

I am writing to inform you that while you may be very good with live animals, your funeral arrangements and service are mediocre. On Friday, they scheduled a pickup for a beloved deceased pet, we provided the address and they quoted the price, but on Monday, if my husband hadn't called, I wouldn't have known they didn't offer pickups in my area. It's deplorable that they play with people's suffering.
Incredible treatment, affection and care for the furry friends.
Excellent professional

I am extremely satisfied with the professionalism of the veterinarians who came to see Kiko, Freddie, and Luna.
Every three months, I have the veterinarian come to my house because my "beasts" hate car rides. This way, I save them and myself from stress.
always a good experience, vets are really nice and helpful.
I liked it; the employee was very friendly and patient.
The veterinarian was very friendly, gave excellent advice for the dog, examined and checked the dog, very satisfied.

The Veterinarians on Wheels have already come to my house twice and I really enjoyed this experience. The two doctors who came to my house to see my two furry friends were very kind and patient with them. Now they are being medicated and the youngest, who wasn't eating any of his food, started eating this morning after his first medication. I am very happy to have opted for these home visits, because in addition to being more advantageous for me, it is better for my furry friends. This home visit service is very affordable, as the prices are not expensive at all, it is even cheaper than going to a veterinary clinic or hospital. Thank you all for your kindness and all the good services you provide to our furry friends, which they also appreciate. 🐾🐾🐾🐾❤️❤️❤️
Dr. Mariana came to my house for the second time to draw blood from my oldest boy. He told me to give him a sedative, which worked well because he managed to draw blood. Now I'm waiting for the test results, maybe next Monday. For now, they are both doing very well. The younger one hasn't been coughing. Only at the end of the medication will we know the correct diagnosis. I like the home visit service from Veterinários sobre Rodas and I highly recommend them. Thank you for your dedication to our furry friends.
Very practical, customer-focused, and informative service.
Excellent service, they came to the house and it was resolved in 30 minutes. I loved it ✨💛 I highly recommend them! …
I loved it, they were super attentive 😊😊 …
They were very helpful and very attentive to Bella, a chihuahua.

Dr. Joana Alves is always very attentive and has a great way with and affectionate towards our furry friends.
Her speed of response and adaptation to our needs is also noteworthy!

My dogs and cats were overjoyed. From the phone service to the in-person appointment, everything was perfect. Just thinking about what I went through taking them to the vet made them so agitated; being at home like this, they don't even realize what's happening 🥰. …

Excellent home service.
They were very quick to provide the service.
The doctor who conducted the consultation was extremely professional, friendly, and helpful.
They offer various services, including home visits, which makes everything more convenient.
Caring professionals.
Affordable prices.
Excellent service, I highly recommend it. Extremely careful and attentive, both the scheduling service and the veterinarian herself, Dr. Bárbara.

First experience with a veterinarian at home. Everything went very smoothly, although I was a little nervous. I have 4 cats, and it's difficult to manage trips to the vet one at a time, as I use public transport and two of them are quite heavy. There are vets nearby, but they aren't always very comfortable answering questions; you can feel a sense of urgency, even just a few steps away. It's a challenge for one of my cats to leave the house; she needs medication to be at least somewhat calm, which makes me nervous.

It was a more relaxed experience for me and my cats not having to leave the house, and although a little nervous, they allowed themselves to be examined and cared for.

There was a willingness to ask additional questions, and Dr. Bárbara showed care and interest in the well-being of my cats, with tips and advice to promote their well-being.

Thank you.
